text:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to deploy console UI v2.4.0 in the 15:00 UTC window today. Who's owning the rollout and smoke checks?
Maria: I can lead. targeting 15:00 UTC + canary at 5% for 10min, then 50% for 10min if no issues. will kick off CDN invalidation after canary looks good.
Alex: Perfect. Can you confirm rollback readiness and any quick preflight checks?
Maria: Rollback plan: revert to v2.3.9 tag, pin assets to previous hash, and route traffic back to old canary slot. I have the tag and the artifact pinned in the deploy pipeline.
Jordan: SRE checklist: confirm edge TTLs, run invalidation script, monitor edge 200s for asset TTLs, and keep an eye on origin error rate. I'll be monitoring latency/5xx.
Emily: I'll run a quick Lighthouse pass and visual diff on staging now so we have screenshots for canary. ping me at start of canary.
Maria: Deploy-bot: queueing canary for v2.4.0.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @maria for env=production, strategy=canary(5%->50%). ETA 15:00 UTC.
Alex: @jordan — what's the exact CDN invalidation command you'll run? want to include in the runbook.
Jordan: I'll use the cloudfront invalidation since this rollout touches hashed assets and also a couple runtime CDN headers we changed: 
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E12AB34CD56 --paths "/static/*" "/console/*"
```
Jordan: I'll set short edge TTL for the next hour: Cache-Control: max-age=60 for html and manifest via the origin config.
Maria: Preflight checklist (short):
- smoke build verification (artifact checksum)
- CDN invalidation ready
- feature flag toggle for canary
- QA visual baseline + lighthouse numbers
- rollback job tested (dry run)

Alex: How do we verify artifact checksum quickly?
Maria: command: 
```
curl -s https://app.redwood.ai/static/js/main.abcdef.js | shasum -a 256
```
Maria: expected sha256: `c3a1...9f2` (already stored in pipeline metadata).
Emily: Staging Lighthouse: Performance 92, Accessibility 98, no regressions on key pages. I captured diffs in /screenshots/canary-2026-03-17.
Alex: Nice. One more: rollback trigger — exact steps?
Maria: Quick steps: disable canary flag in LaunchDarkly -> pipeline auto-deploys v2.3.9 -> CDN invalidation for the older hash -> confirm main assets 200s match old checksum. I have the pipeline runbook in the deploy doc.
Jordan: I'll keep an open pager and watch the dashboards (latency, 5xx, edge error rates). If anything spikes in first 10m of canary I will signal rollback.
Alex: OK. At 15:00 I'll handoff to @maria for the start. I'll be available for coordination.
deploy-bot: Deploy starting: canary (5%) for v2.4.0 — kicked off by @maria.
Maria: Starting canary now. Emily please start visual checks. Jordan watching infra.
Emily: Visual checks started — snapshotting core flows: login, org dashboard, notebook list.
Jordan: CDN invalidation queued but waiting for green on canary metrics.
Alex: If canary holds for 10m, increase to 50%. Maria — confirm when you bump.
Maria: Bumping to 50% now. :rocket:
Alex: :thumbsup: keep an eye on user-reported errors, console logs and Sentry.
Emily: Lighthouse on canary at 50%: Performance 90, negligible diffs. No new console errors in the sampled sessions.
Jordan: Metrics look stable. 5xx at baseline, p95 latency +5ms. proceeding to full release in next 10.
Maria: Post-canary steps: run full CDN invalidation for `/console/*` and `/static/*`, kick cache warmup for most-requested assets.
Alex: Rollback checklist still ready?
Maria: Yes. Rollback job queued and verified. If we need it I will initiate and comment here.
sre-bot: Reminder: create incident if user-impacting errors > 0.5% for 5min.
Alex: Sounds good. updating the release board and marking this thread resolved after full invalidation. Thanks team. :tada:
